longDescription:
## Purpose

The Energy Label component enables compliance with EU energy labeling regulations by displaying energy efficiency information for applicable products such as lighting, appliances, and electronics. It provides customers with standardized energy consumption data to support environmentally conscious purchasing decisions.

## Use Cases

- Displaying energy label information in a lightbox modal
- Showing thumbnail energy label preview within the buy box
- Linking to detailed product datasheets for technical specifications
- Supporting EU regulatory compliance for energy-related products

## Design Rationale

The component uses a compact thumbnail in the buy box to avoid visual clutter while providing full label details on demand through the lightbox. This approach balances regulatory compliance with clean product page design. The optional datasheet link supports customers who need detailed technical specifications beyond the standard energy label information.
